findings.title: Pathway plan does not update after interview
findings.impact: Users finish an interview and feedback but the learning pathway stays stale or shows a perpetual “catching up” state — core post-interview loop is broken.
evidence: Manual UAT on production: pathway unchanged after completing a new interview
Harness: 60/60 sessions — pathway view-model state remains pending after 120s poll
Root cause: Inngest Cloud missing pathway-regenerate (6/8 functions synced)
Fix: re-sync to 8 functions + bulk replay 59/59 stuck QA sessions
nextSteps: Overnight harness v2 run should show pathwayGenerationStatus=succeeded on ≥95% sessions
Product hardening: stale pending recovery + post-deploy Inngest function count check
